original_value: In this work, we demonstrate a Chinese classical poetry generation system called Deep Poetry. Existing systems for Chinese classical poetry generation are mostly template-based and very few of them can accept multi-modal input. Unlike previous systems, Deep Poetry uses neural networks that are trained on over 200 thousand poems and 3 million ancient Chinese prose. Our system can accept plain text, images or artistic conceptions as inputs to generate Chinese classical poetry. More importantly, users are allowed to participate in the process of writing poetry by our system. For the user's convenience, we deploy the system at the WeChat applet platform, users can use the system on the mobile device whenever and wherever possible.

result.paraphrase: This paper presents Deep Poetry, a Chinese classical poetry generation system. Most existing Chinese classical poetry generators are template based, and very few can take multimodal inputs. In contrast, Deep Poetry employs neural networks trained on more than 200,000 poems and 3 million pieces of ancient Chinese prose. It can generate Chinese classical poetry from plain text, images, or artistic conceptions. More importantly, the system lets users take part in the poetry-writing process. For convenience, it is deployed as a WeChat applet, allowing use on mobile devices anytime and anywhere.
